title: AML/CTF obligations extended to lawyers providing designated services
summary: From 1 July 2026, law practices and lawyers providing designated services must enrol with AUSTRAC and comply with the anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism financing regime.
what_changes: Firms providing designated services must enrol with AUSTRAC and have an AML/CTF program in place.
Firms must appoint an AML/CTF compliance officer.
Staff must be trained on the program, internal processes and relevant AML/CTF risks.
Firms must carry out customer due diligence and report suspicious matters.
who_it_applies_to: Law practices and lawyers that provide AML/CTF designated services.

history.event: AML/CTF obligations for lawyers providing designated services commenced on 1 July 2026.
